name: Mango
description: Mango is an AI agent that turns natural language questions into MongoDB queries (NL to MQL) through an LLM-based orchestration system. It combines a FastAPI backend with real-time streaming, a three-layer vector-store memory for few-shot learning, and support for multiple LLM providers including local models via Ollama. It is read-only by design, rejecting write operations at the tool level for safe production use.
